header: Use the advanced hunting query resource report
content:
report
Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel in the Microsoft Defender portal
The query resources report shows your organization's consumption of CPU resources for
hunting based on queries that ran in the last 30 days by using any of the hunting interfaces.
This report is useful for identifying the most resource-intensive queries and understanding how
to prevent throttling due to excessive use.
To keep the service performant and responsive, advanced hunting sets various quotas and
usage parameters (also known as "service limits"). For more information, see Quotas and usage
parameters.
You can access the report in two ways:
In the advanced hunting page, select Query resources report:
In the Reports page, find the new report entry in the General section.
